reviewContext.issueReference: No GitHub issue. workflowInput 'Split Telescreen, Inventory and Notification into independently deployable services' (workflowExecutionId opus-luna-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-18, plan review comm-000898 accepted); requirements design-docs/specs/design-service-split-requirements.md (R1-R8, D1-D5); accepted design design-docs/specs/design-service-split.md.
reviewContext.userProblem: Inventory was extracted as a service but still calls back into Telescreen for authentication, issue enrichment, actor names, assignee fallback, audit and retention delivery, and notification runs inside the main process sharing the caller transaction and main store. The owner wants Telescreen, Inventory and Notification each deployable as a microservice, with Inventory and Notification never calling Telescreen.
requiredOutcomes: Inventory serves all /api/data/* routes with unchanged responses and permissions, authenticates OIDC bearers and API tokens from its own directory replica (D1, C4), serves issue enrichment from a pushed issue-link projection (D3), keeps its own audit chain (D5), and publishes overdue notifications while Telescreen is stopped; no inventory code path calls Telescreen.

A new telescreen-notification process with its own store, migrations, delivery pump, templates, preferences, DLP (producer redaction hits folded into DlpGate, DR-1), replica recipient resolution and audit chain; Telescreen and Inventory hold no SMTP/Slack credentials in split mode.

Every notification producer in Telescreen and Inventory publishes versioned NotificationCommands through a durable outbox committed with producer state; deterministic notification row ids; idempotent applied/duplicate/deferred receipts.

db/ownership.py declares three disjoint stores (MAIN 50, INVENTORY 15, NOTIFICATION 9 tables; 74 total); Nodetto, exports, models, legacy revision 0010, owner histories main_0002, inventory_0002, notification_0001 with adoption; notification-store copy/verify cutover.

Import gates and multi-process TCP tests prove dependency directions, outage/replay recovery and DLP parity; the leak matrix covers replicas, outboxes, wire bodies, logs and audit exports; restricted-login PostgreSQL tests deny cross-store SQL (integration, skipped offline).

The single-process default composition passes the full existing suite unchanged; mise run ci, ddl-check, web-ci and uv build pass; README, design docs, command docs and compose overlay docker-compose.services.yml updated.
nonGoals: Splitting collection from issues, a message broker or service mesh, or executing a production migration (requirements section 6).
A notification-history list API or UI (C6); src/web does not change.
Keeping the bde11e7 inventory-only remote mode (C9): supported topologies are single process and full split.
constraints: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md: English only, no emojis, python-coding-standards, plans under 400 lines, Python files under 1000 lines.
Strict typing enforced by tools/typelint.py, ruff ANN/PGH and ty; no Any, object, dict or **kwargs; dataclasses or enums; no type-ignore; tooling not weakened.

Raw detected values, raw item keys and source content never enter any table, log, outbox, replica, wire message, notification, export or API response; only masked forms, hit counts and keyed fingerprints.
At-least-once delivery with idempotent receipts, durable outboxes committed with producer state, no distributed transactions, no in-memory callbacks.
DDL: Nodetto JSONL first, then ddl-arrange, ddl-export, models, new Alembic and owner-history revisions; never edit existing revisions or packaged baselines.
Default uv run pytest passes offline; integration and live tests skip and are never listed as verification or risks (conventions 7a).
Commit and push only to feat/service-split.
designDecisionsAndRationale: D1 + C4: Inventory and Notification verify OIDC bearers and API tokens against a pushed directory replica via ReplicaAuthenticator, with error codes identical to api/common/auth.py.

D2: Telescreen publishes revisioned DirectoryEntity values (counters.directory_revision, only-if-newer apply, tombstones) through flush markers and a serialized relay; Inventory receives no email/slack fields (data minimization).
DR-2: the relay takes the counter lock before reading entity state and deletes markers by id, so a concurrent revoke is never lost.
D3: IssueLinkState and DirectoryUpdate are additive InventoryCommand kinds on the existing ordered outbox/inbox (schema version stays 1).
D4 + DR-1: producers redact inline text and context strings and send count-only ProducerRedactionHits; Notification folds them into DlpGate so verdicts match single process.
D5: per-store audit chains through AuditChainModels; Inventory stops sending audit commands to Telescreen; audit verify/export CLIs per service.

C1/R5: /retention-status is removed; Inventory checks retention eligibility in the same transaction that writes the notification command, reusing the obligation id as event_id for cross-cutover dedup.
C5: notifications/weekly.py moves to issues/weekly_report.py and stays a Telescreen producer.
Shared replica/audit runtime is a separate plan (svc-p07) so svc-p04 and svc-p05 run in parallel.
intentionalTradeoffs: Replicas are eventually consistent: an unknown recipient within notification_replica_grace_seconds (default 600) is deferred with no writes; after grace it is recorded as SKIPPED recipient_unknown.

Five owner-review defaults (replicated API tokens, shared identity key, pending receipts, CLI audit path, two topologies) apply while pending in design-docs/user-qa/pending-service-split-tradeoffs.md.

Three design corrections (api_token label in 4.1, notifications.dlp/guard allowance in the section 15 gate, actual plan shape in section 17) land in design-service-split.md in wave 5 via svc-p08; until then each plan takes precedence for its own scope.

Wave-4 full-suite runs in svc-p04/p05/p06 are informational because tests/inventory_service/test_process.py and test_postgres.py (old inventory-only remote mode, owned by svc-p08) may fail until wave 5; scoped runs are the gate.
supportedEdgeCases: Relay and concurrent API token revoke or issue status change (deterministic SQLite after_read schedule; PostgreSQL two-connection variant marked integration).
Lost reply after applied command returns duplicate with no duplicate rows; reused event id with a different digest is a conflict.
Notification, Inventory or Telescreen stopped while producers commit; restart applies commands once and in order.
Superseded retention obligation produces no command and an overdue_superseded audit; owner fallback via issue link plus identity, then ownership rules team.
Cutover: copied retention receipt makes the overdue command a duplicate; copied queued notifications without delivery state are seeded and delivered once.
Setting only one service URL, or a single-process notification database URL different from main, is a ConfigError before any resource opens.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Mixed topologies with only one extracted service.
